findings.summary: dev script references ts-node which is not installed; project uses tsx
evidence: "dev": "ts-node src/cli.ts" — but devDependencies has tsx, not ts-node
findings.suggestion: Change dev script to: "dev": "tsx src/cli.ts" to match the actual dev toolchain

findings.summary: V1, V2, V3 manifest structures and migration functions kept for runtime backward compatibility
evidence: interface XfgManifestV1 { version: 1; managedFiles: string[] }
interface XfgManifestV2 { version: 2; configs: Record<string, string[]> }
interface XfgManifestV3 { version: 3; ... rulesets?: string[]; labels?: string[] }
function migrateV2ToV3(v2: XfgManifestV2): XfgManifestV3
function migrateV3ToV4(v3: XfgManifestV3): XfgManifest
findings.suggestion: This is intentional backward-compat for existing users' repos — no action needed unless a major version drop of V1/V2 support is desired. Consider adding a deprecation timeline comment.

findings.summary: Comment about ESM compatibility and interface handling is stale — inline export type is already used
evidence: // Export types - using 'export type' for type aliases, but interfaces need special handling
// For ESM compatibility, re-export everything from types.js
Lines 8-14 already use `type` keyword inline, making the comment misleading
findings.suggestion: Remove or update the stale comments on lines 4-5 of src/cli/index.ts

findings.summary: shared/gh-api-utils.ts imports from vcs/ module, violating the dependency direction (shared should be lowest-level)
evidence: import type { GitHubAppTokenManager } from "../vcs/github-app-token-manager.js";
gh-api-utils.ts lives in shared/ but depends on vcs/ — a coupling-direction failure
findings.suggestion: Move gh-api-utils.ts to vcs/ (where its consumers mostly are), or extract the token-manager type dependency to shared/ as an interface

findings.summary: shared/repo-detector.ts and shared/retry-utils.ts import ValidationError from config/, inverting the dependency direction
evidence: src/shared/repo-detector.ts:1:import { ValidationError } from "../config/errors.js";
src/shared/retry-utils.ts:3:import { ValidationError } from "../config/errors.js";
ValidationError is a generic error class living in config/ but used by shared/, vcs/, cli/, and settings/
findings.suggestion: Move ValidationError to shared/errors.ts since it is a general-purpose error class, not config-specific. This would fix the coupling-direction violation.

findings.summary: shared/index.ts barrel omits 5 files that have significant external usage
evidence: type-guards.ts: 23 external imports, not in barrel
gh-api-utils.ts: 12 external imports, not in barrel
string-utils.ts: 3 external imports, not in barrel
xfg-template.ts: 2 external imports, not in barrel
file-status.ts: 1 external import, not in barrel
findings.suggestion: Add the heavily-imported modules (at minimum type-guards and gh-api-utils) to the shared barrel, or document that direct imports are the intended pattern for shared/

findings.summary: shared/ has 14 non-index files mixing concerns: logging, shell, retry, env, git detection, GitHub API, templating, string utils
evidence: 14 files in one flat directory: logger, shell-utils, retry-utils, env, repo-detector, gh-api-utils, xfg-template, interpolation-engine, command-executor, type-guards, sanitize-utils, string-utils, workspace-utils, file-status
findings.suggestion: This is borderline — the files are individually small and cohesive. Consider at minimum moving gh-api-utils to vcs/ where it has stronger affinity. No major restructuring required.

findings.summary: shared/xfg-template.ts imports ContentValue type from config/, creating another upward dependency
evidence: src/shared/xfg-template.ts:14:import type { ContentValue } from "../config/index.js";
findings.suggestion: Define ContentValue (or the subset needed) in shared/ to eliminate the upward dependency, or move xfg-template to a module that can depend on config/
